descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Die Chance

Im Rahmen unserer laufenden digitalen Transformationsreise entwickeln wir ACE, eine hochmoderne, KI-fähige Plattform, die die Effizienz und Genauigkeit unseres Bid & Proposal Management-Prozesses innerhalb der Transformers Business Unit verbessern soll. Wir suchen einen Prompt-Ingenieur, der eine zentrale Rolle in dieser Initiative spielen wird. Diese Person wird für die Gestaltung, Erprobung und Optimierung domänenspezifischer Aufforderungen verantwortlich sein, die es ACE ermöglichen, präzise, kontext- und unternehmensorientierte Ergebnisse zu generieren.

Die Rolle erfordert ein tiefes Verständnis der Transformatorenindustrie, der industriellen Ausrüstungsstandards sowie ein grundlegendes Verständnis der schnellen technischen Best Practices und des GenAI-Modellverhaltens, wodurch ACE hochwertige Antworten liefert, die auf komplexe Geschäftsszenarien zugeschnitten sind. Der ideale Kandidat wird eng mit IT-Experten, Experten für Themenfragen, Business-Stakeholdern und Modul-Besitzern zusammenarbeiten, um komplexe Geschäftslogik in domänenspezifische Eingabeaufforderungen aufzuschlüsseln.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen

- Entwicklung, Verfeinerung und Wartung prompter Bibliotheken für verschiedene Transformatoreneinheiten/Fabriken. - Implementierung fortgeschrittener Techniken wie promptes Kettenen, Kontexteinspritzen und wenige-Schüsse-Lernen für Enterprise-Grade-Genauigkeit. - Eigenes promptes Lebenszyklusmanagement einschließlich Versionierung, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Governance. - Auswertung LLM-Antworten für Präzision, Compliance und Bias-Abschwächung. - Durchführung von A/B-Tests und Wartung von Performance-Dashboards für prompte Wirksamkeit. - Arbeiten Sie eng mit Modulbesitzern, Subjekt Materie Experten und Business-Pragern zusammen, um Prompte in ACE-Workflows zu integrieren.

- Erstellen Sie eine klare Dokumentation für schnelle Strategien und halten Sie bewährte Verfahren in Einklang mit Hitachi Energys KI-Ethik-Charta. - Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über neue GenAI-Technologien, -Frames und -Tools zur Verbesserung der ACE-Fähigkeiten. - Umsetzung und Empfehlung von Best Practices für die Aufforderung über verschiedene ACE-Module.

Anforderungen

- Bachelor oder Master in Elektrotechnik - Erfahrung in der Transformatorenindustrie, mit internationalen Standards und Kundendokumentation - Starkes Problem-Lösungs- und analytisches Denken - Starkes sprachliches und logisches Denken für die Erstellung präziser Vorladungen - Starkes Verständnis von NLP, Kontextmanagement und Tokenoptimierung - Fähigkeit, die Ergebnisse zu experimentieren und zu optimieren - Fähigkeit, Geschäftsprozesse zu verstehen und in ACE-spezifische Vorladungen zu übersetzen - Hands-on-Erfahrung mit LLMs und prompte Engineering-Techniken - Starkes Interesse an KI

Enterprise-Grade-Lösungen - Bereitschaft, Python zu lernen und Erfahrungen mit AI-APIs-Dienstleistungen - Fähigkeit, in agilen Umgebungen zu arbeiten und mehrere Stakeholder zu verwalten - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten - Analytische Einstellung mit Liebe zum Detail - Empathie für Endbenutzer und Neugier zum Experimentieren - Engagement für ethische KI-Praktiken und kontinuierliches Lernen

Was wir anbieten

- Wettbewerbive Gehalt und Anreize - Wohlbefinden und Pflege - Bezahlter und unbezahlter Urlaub - Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten - Vorteile, die Ihre finanzielle Sicherheit unterstützen

Sie erhalten während des Rekrutierungsprozesses genauere Informationen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

L'opportunité

Dans le cadre de notre parcours de transformation numérique, nous développons ACE, une plateforme de pointe à moteur d'IA Generative conçue pour améliorer l'efficacité et la précision de notre processus de gestion des soumissions et des propositions au sein de l'unité commerciale des transformateurs. Nous recherchons un ingénieur prompt qui jouera un rôle central dans cette initiative.

Le rôle exige une compréhension approfondie de l'industrie de la transformation, des normes d'équipement industriel ainsi que de la compréhension de base des meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie et du comportement modèle GenAI, en veillant à ce qu'ACE fournisse des réponses de haute qualité adaptées aux scénarios d'affaires complexes. Le candidat idéal collaborera étroitement avec les experts en TI, les experts en matière de sujets, les intervenants commerciaux et les propriétaires de modules pour décomposer la logique d'affaires complexe en des prompts spécifiques à domaine.

Comment vous allez faire un impact

- Mettre en oeuvre des techniques avancées comme la chaîne rapide, l'injection de contexte et l'apprentissage à faible dose pour la précision de l'entreprise. - Gestion du cycle de vie rapide de l'entreprise, y compris la mise en forme, la traçabilité et la gouvernance. - Évaluer les réponses aux MLG pour en déterminer la précision, la conformité et l'atténuation des biais. - Effectuer des essais A/B et maintenir les tableaux de bord de performance pour en assurer l'efficacité rapide. - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de modules, les experts en matière de sujets et les intervenants commerciaux pour intégrer les invitations dans les flux de travail ACE.

- Créer une documentation claire pour des stratégies rapides et maintenir les meilleures pratiques conformes à la Charte éthique de l'IA d'Hitachi Energy. - Restez informé des nouvelles technologies, cadres et outils de l'IAGG pour améliorer les capacités de l'ACE. - Mettre en oeuvre et recommander des pratiques exemplaires pour inciter à l'élaboration de différents modules de l'ACE.

Besoins

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique - Expérience dans l'industrie de la transformation, avec des normes internationales et de la documentation client - Résolution de problèmes et réflexion analytique - Raisonnement linguistique et logique fort pour élaborer des prompts précis - Connaissance approfondie des NLP, de la gestion du contexte et de l'optimisation des jetons - Capacité d'expérimenter et d'optimiser les extrants - Capacité de comprendre les processus d'affaires et de les traduire en prompts spécifiques à l'ACE - Expérience pratique avec les LLM et techniques d'ingénierie rapides - Intérêt marqué pour l'IA

solutions de qualité entreprise - Volonté d'apprendre Python et expérience avec les services API d'IA - Capacité de travailler dans des environnements agiles et de gérer plusieurs parties prenantes - Excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration - Mentalité analytique avec attention aux détails - Empathy pour les utilisateurs finaux et curiosité pour l'expérimentation - Engagement envers les pratiques éthiques en matière d'IA et l'apprentissage continu

jobs.title: Senior R&D Test Engineer – SiC/Si 80–100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our Product Evaluation & Qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, where we ensure the highest quality and reliability standards for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules.   Our products play a critical role in enabling renewable energy, eMobility, traction, and industrial applications worldwide. As we continue to expand our testing capabilities, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Senior R&D Test Engineer to support the development and qualification of innovative Silicon Carbide (SiC) and Silicon (Si) technologies. In this role, you will work at the interface of R&D, product engineering, and testing, helping bring advanced semiconductor technologies from development to industrialization.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to the development and qualification of next-generation Silicon Carbide (SiC) and Silicon (Si) semiconductor devices for power module applications Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across R&D Design, Process Development, and Product Engineering to evaluate the performance and reliability of new technologies Plan, execute, and monitor electrical and reliability tests using advanced test equipment and methodologies Analyze test data, identify trends and root causes, and provide technical recommendations to support product development decisions. Prepare and present test reports, communicating key findings and risks to project stakeholders Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the testing laboratory, enhancing efficiency, quality, and testing capabilities Enure compliance with safety, environmental, cleanliness, and laboratory operating standards in all testing activities   Your background   Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in the semiconductor, power electronics, or related industry, ideally within electrical testing, validation, or reliability engineering Strong understanding of semiconductor devices, particularly Silicon Carbide (SiC) and\/or Silicon (Si) technologies Experience with test systems, measurement equipment, and data analysis methodologies Programming or automation skills are highly desirable, preferably in Python, LabVIEW, or similar tools Experience with statistical data analysis and engineering software tools; CAD knowledge is considered a plus Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured and collaborative working style Fluent in English; German is an advantage   More about us     The opportunity to work on cutting-edge semiconductor technologies that enable the global energy transition Collaboration with highly skilled experts in an international and innovative environment Challenging projects with real impact on future power electronics solutions Flexible working arrangements and attractive development opportunities within a global technology leader

strumenti simili - Esperienza con l'analisi statistica dei dati e strumenti software di ingegneria; conoscenza CAD è considerato un plus - Forte capacità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi, combinata con uno stile di lavoro strutturato e collaborativo - Fluente in inglese; il tedesco è un vantaggio

Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten. e condivisione delle conoscenze dei servizi - Gestire l'intero processo di offerta dei progetti di servizi, dall'identificazione delle opportunità e preparazione delle quotazioni attraverso la negoziazione dei contratti e il trasferimento all'esecuzione - Utilizzare strumenti digitali, sistemi CRM e analisi delle vendite per garantire la qualità dei dati, mantenere previsioni accurate e migliorare l'esperienza dei clienti - monitorare le performance aziendali contro gli obiettivi, individuare le lacune, sviluppare i bilanci annuali degli ordini e attuare azioni per raggiungere obiettivi di crescita - Mentor e supportare i team di vendita dei servizi presso Product Service Center e Local Service Unit, promuovere una cultura di

in inglese; ulteriori lingue come lo spagnolo sono un plus - Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale fino al 50%

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Die Möglichkeit als Area Sales Manager, werden Sie die Marktdurchdringung und profitables Wachstum für unser Portfolio an Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) und Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) Service vorantreiben. Sie werden lokale Vertriebsteams führen und stärken, Kundenbeziehungen pflegen und digitale Tools nutzen, um außergewöhnlichen Service und Ergebnisse zu liefern.

Unser Service ist für die weltweite Nachverkaufsunterstützung von GCB- und GIS-Systemen sowohl für die Übertragung (220kV-550kV) als auch für die Sub-Übertragung (60kV-170kV) verantwortlich, einschließlich Schulung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, planmäßige Wartung, Mehrwertdienste, Fehlerbehebung, Modifikation, Nachrüstung und Ersatz.

Zuständigkeiten

- Definieren und führen Sie Go-to-Market-Strategien zusammen mit lokalen Service-Vertriebsteams, Channel-Partnern und Service-Organisationen, um nachhaltiges Auftragswachstum zu fördern - Führen Sie proaktive Vertriebs- und Marketingaktivitäten für Wartungs- und Servicelösungen und optimieren Sie dabei regionale Preisstrategien und steigern Sie die Marktdurchdringung - Analysieren Sie installierte Basisdaten, Marktdynamiken und Kundenbedürfnisse, um Verkaufsaktionspläne zu entwickeln und die Wartungs-Vertriebspipeline zu erweitern - Aufbauen Sie starke Kunden- und Partnerbeziehungen, bieten Sie Beratung und ermöglichen Sie lokale Service-Vertriebsteams durch Produkt

und Service Knowledge Sharing - Verwalten Sie den gesamten Service-Projekt Angebotsprozess, von der Chancenerkennung und Angebotsvorbereitung über Vertragsverhandlungen und Übergabe bis zur Ausführung - Verwenden Sie digitale Tools, CRM-Systeme und Vertriebsanalysen, um Datenqualität zu gewährleisten, genaue Prognosen zu halten und die Kundenerfahrung zu verbessern - Überwachen Sie die Geschäftsleistung gegen Ziele, Lücken zu erkennen, jährliche Auftragsbudgets zu entwickeln und Maßnahmen zur Erreichung von Wachstumszielen umzusetzen - Mentor und unterstützen Service Sales Teams bei Product Service Center und Local Service Unit, fördern eine Kultur der

kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Antriebssteigerungen von Vertriebsprozessen und Tools

Anforderungen

- Studium der technischen oder kaufmännischen Fachrichtung - Bewährte Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Geschäftsentwicklung oder Account Management im Energie-, Industrie- oder Infrastruktursektor - Starke kommerzielle Fähigkeiten und Verhandlungskompetenzen mit einer Erfolgsbilanz - Kundenorientierter Ansatz und die Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen über verschiedene Märkte und Kulturen hinweg aufzubauen - Erfahrung mit Salesforce, SAP und anderen digitalen Vertriebsinstrumenten - Starke Kommunikation, Präsentation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten - Selbstmotiviert, belastbar und angetrieben, um Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu schaffen - Fluent

in Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen wie Spanisch sind ein Plus - Bereitschaft, international bis zu 50% reisen

Was wir anbieten

- Interessante und bereichernde Arbeit als Teil eines dynamischen, leidenschaftlichen und kollaborativen Teams, das sich der Innovation und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung verpflichtet - Flexibles Arbeiten, einschließlich hybrider/remote Arbeitsmöglichkeiten - Ein kompensations- und erfolgsorientiertes Paket

Ansprechpartner

Hitachi Energy kann Ihnen eine interessante Rolle in einem hochmotivierten Team bieten, zusammen mit offener Kommunikation und einer Kultur, die die Zusammenarbeit, die Verbindung und die Vielfalt des Denkens fördert.

Designazione delle merci

Per quanto riguarda la posizione di leader del team/in montaggio elettrico presso la fabbrica di valvole GI di Seon o Turgi, si guida un team di circa 15 dipendenti. Si assume un ruolo centrale nel controllo giornaliero della produzione. Si coordinano le attività operative all'interno del team e si assicurano che i processi di assemblaggio, testing e logistica funzionino in modo efficiente, sicuro e orientato alla qualità. Siete la persona di contatto diretto per i dipendenti e lavorare a stretto contatto con la gestione della produzione e altre interfacce.

Il vostro impegno è un importante contributo al raggiungimento dei nostri obiettivi produttivi e al miglioramento continuo delle nostre prestazioni.

Oltre ad attività di coordinamento, siete attivamente coinvolti nel processo di assemblaggio (circa 50%).

Questo è ciò che state portando: - Formazione professionale tecnica (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, installazione elettrica, meccatronica) - Formazione continua come tecnico HF di vantaggio - Diversi anni di esperienza nell'assemblaggio di componenti elettrici - Esperienza come team leader e buone capacità di comunicazione - Tedesco in parole e scrittura, competenze inglesi di vantaggio - Conoscenza e esperienza SAP con i sistemi di produzione digitale (MES) sono un plus

Maggiori informazioni su di noi: i nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili consentono di ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e professionali e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possano sviluppare e sviluppare le proprie competenze.

Description

About the position as team leader/in electrical assembly at the GI Valves factory in Seon or Turgi you lead a team of about 15 employees. You take on a central role in the daily production control. You coordinate operational activities within the team and ensure that assembly, testing and logistics processes run efficiently, safely and in a quality-oriented manner. You are the direct contact person for the employees and work closely with the production management and other interfaces.

Your commitment is a major contribution to achieving our production goals and continuously improving our performance.

This is what you are bringing: - Technical vocational training (e.g. electrical engineering, electrical installation, mechatronics) - Further training as a technician HF of advantage - Several years of experience in the assembly of electrical components - Experience as a team leader and good communication skills - German in word and writing, English skills of advantage - SAP knowledge and experience with digital production systems (MES) are a plus

More about us: Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment in which all employees can develop and grow their skills.

jobs.title: Installed Base Manager 40 - 50% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you analytical, structured, and energized by turning complex data into real business impact? Do you want a role with global reach where the data you own becomes a direct lever for Sales, Service, and business growth? Then we have the ideal opportunity for you! As Installed Base Manager at our Product Service Centre in Zurich, you will take ownership of the worldwide installed base for the high voltage products manufactured at our Swiss factories. Based in our Product Management and Marketing team, you will collaborate closely with Country Installed Base Managers around the globe, safeguard the accuracy of service history and asset data, and empower Sales, Service, and technical functions with dashboards and analyses that drive business decisions. How you'll make an impact Safeguard the data quality of the global installed base for our Swiss-manufactured high voltage products Build strong working relationships with our Country Installed Base Managers worldwide, act as their central product counterpart, and jointly identify bottlenecks, opportunities, and priorities Prepare, analyze, and enrich large data sets, identify errors, and continuously improve data quality Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and tailored analyses that empower Service Sales, Area Sales Managers, and technical troubleshooting teams Deliver cross-functional digital analyses and dashboards that create value beyond the installed base scope Ensure a smooth data handover from new business to service in close collaboration with the Quality department, and partner with Field Service Management to keep field data accurate Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in industrial engineering, business informatics, data science, or a related field; open to both recent graduates and candidates with some years of relevant experience Strong analytical mindset and a passion for data quality, with structured and reproducible ways of working Experience with Power BI, or a clear motivation to build up these skills; SAP knowledge is beneficial and SQL is a plus Curiosity and a problem-solver's mindset: you enjoy digging into complex topics and designing pragmatic solutions A balance of vision and adaptability, with comfort in guiding stakeholders through change Strong collaboration and communication skills across functions and regions Fluent English is mandatory; German and any other language are considered an asset More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'opportunità Siete analitici, strutturati ed energici trasformando dati complessi in un vero e proprio impatto commerciale? Volete un ruolo a portata globale dove i dati che possiedi diventano una leva diretta per Sales, Service e Business Growth? Allora abbiamo l'opportunità ideale per voi!

Come Installato Base Manager presso il nostro Centro Assistenza Prodotti di Zurigo, potrai acquisire la proprietà della base installata a livello mondiale per i prodotti ad alta tensione prodotti presso i nostri stabilimenti svizzeri. Con sede nel nostro team di Gestione Prodotti e Marketing, collaborerai a stretto contatto con i Country Installato Base Manager in tutto il mondo, salvaguardando l'accuratezza della cronologia dei servizi e dei dati relativi agli asset, e potenziando le funzioni di vendita, servizio e tecnica con dashboard e analisi che guidano le decisioni aziendali.

Come farete un impatto - Salvaguardare la qualità dei dati della base installata globale per i nostri prodotti ad alta tensione fabbricati in Svizzera - Costruire forti rapporti di lavoro con i nostri gestori di base installati in tutto il mondo, agire come controparte centrale del prodotto, e insieme identificare strozzature, opportunità e priorità - Preparare, analizzare e arricchire grandi set di dati, identificare errori e migliorare continuamente la qualità dei dati - Sviluppare e mantenere dashboard Power BI e analisi personalizzate che potenziano le vendite di servizi, Sales Manager Area e team di risoluzione dei problemi tecnici - Consegnare

analisi digitali cross-funzionali e dashboard che creano valore oltre l'ambito base installato - Assicurate un trasferimento regolare dei dati da una nuova attività a un servizio in stretta collaborazione con il reparto Qualità e collaborate con Field Service Management per mantenere precisi i dati sul campo

Il tuo background - Laurea o laurea magistrale in ingegneria industriale, informatica aziendale, informatica o un campo correlato; aperto sia a laureati recenti che a candidati con alcuni anni di esperienza rilevante - Una forte mentalità analitica e una passione per la qualità dei dati, con modalità di lavoro strutturate e riproducibili - L'esperienza con Power BI, o una chiara motivazione per sviluppare queste competenze; SAP conoscenza è utile e SQL è un plus - Curiosità e una mentalità di soluzione dei problemi: ti piace scavare in temi complessi e progettare soluzioni pragmatiche - Un equilibrio di visione e SQL è un plus - Curiosità e una mentalità di soluzione dei problemi: ti piace scavare in temi complessi e progettare soluzioni pragmatiche - Un equilibrio di visione e

adattabilità, con il comfort di guidare gli stakeholder attraverso il cambiamento - Forte collaborazione e capacità di comunicazione tra funzioni e regioni - L'inglese fluente è obbligatorio; il tedesco e qualsiasi altra lingua sono considerati un bene

Più su di noi Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono veramente supportate e giustamente ricompensate. I nostri benefici sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo. l'impegno di alimentazione, le prestazioni e la crescita. Da priorità benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Die Chance Sind Sie analytisch, strukturiert und durch die Umwandlung komplexer Daten in echte Geschäftseffekte erenergetisiert? Wollen Sie eine Rolle mit globaler Reichweite, wo die eigenen Daten zu einem direkten Hebel für Sales, Service und Unternehmenswachstum werden? Dann haben wir die ideale Chance für Sie!

Als Installierter Basismanager in unserem Produktservicecenter in Zürich übernehmen Sie die weltweit installierte Basis für die in unseren Schweizer Werken hergestellten Hochspannungsprodukte. Mit Sitz in unserem Produktmanagement- und Marketingteam arbeiten Sie eng mit Country Installierten Basismanagern rund um den Globus zusammen, sichern die Genauigkeit der Servicehistorie und der Anlagendaten und stärken mit Dashboards und Analysen Vertriebs-, Service- und technische Funktionen, die Geschäftsentscheidungen vorantreiben.

Wie Sie die Datenqualität der weltweit installierten Basis für unsere Schweizer Hochvoltprodukte sichern - Starke Arbeitsbeziehungen mit unseren Country-Installed Base Managern weltweit aufbauen, als zentrales Produkt-Gegenstück fungieren und Engpässe, Chancen und Prioritäten gemeinsam identifizieren - Große Datensätze vorbereiten, analysieren und bereichern, Fehler erkennen und die Datenqualität kontinuierlich verbessern - Power BI-Dashboards entwickeln und pflegen sowie maßgeschneiderte Analysen erstellen, die Service Sales, Area Sales Manager und technische Troubleshooting Teams stärken - Bereitstellung

crossfunktionale digitale Analysen und Dashboards, die Wert über den installierten Basisbereich hinaus schaffen - In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Abteilung Qualität und Partner mit Field Service Management eine reibungslose Datenübergabe vom Neugeschäft an den Service gewährleisten, um Felddaten genau zu halten

Ihr Hintergrund - Bachelor oder Master in Industrieingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Datenwissenschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich; offen für junge Absolventen und Kandidaten mit einigen Jahren einschlägiger Erfahrung - Starke analytische Denkweise und eine Leidenschaft für Datenqualität, mit strukturierten und reproduzierbaren Arbeitsweisen - Erfahrung mit Power BI, oder eine klare Motivation, diese Fähigkeiten aufzubauen; SAP-Wissen ist vorteilhaft und SQL ist ein Plus - Neugier und ein Problem-Lösungs-Denken: Sie genießen es, komplexe Themen zu erforschen und pragmatische Lösungen zu entwerfen - Ein Gleichgewicht der Vision und

Anpassungsfähigkeit, mit Komfort bei der Steuerung der Stakeholder durch Wandel - Starke Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg - fließendes Englisch ist Pflicht; Deutsch und jede andere Sprache gelten als ein Vorteil

Mehr über uns Wir glauben, dass große Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgelegt, für jeden Einzelnen einen echten Wert zu schaffen – für Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum. Durch die Priorisierung des Wohlbefindens bauen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem persönliche und organisatorische Erfolge zusammen wachsen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description L'opportunité Êtes-vous analytique, structuré et énergizé en transformant des données complexes en un impact commercial réel? Voulez-vous un rôle avec une portée globale où les données que vous possédez deviennent un levier direct pour les ventes, le service et la croissance d'entreprise? Alors nous avons l'opportunité idéale pour vous!

En tant que Responsable de Base Installé dans notre Centre de Service Produit à Zurich, vous vous approprierez la base installée mondialement pour les produits haute tension fabriqués dans nos usines suisses. Basés dans notre équipe de Gestion Produit et Marketing, vous collaborerez étroitement avec Country Installé Responsables de Base dans le monde entier, préserverez l'exactitude de l'historique de service et des données d'actifs, et autonomiserez les fonctions commerciales, de service et techniques avec des tableaux de bord et des analyses qui conduisent les décisions d'affaires.

Comment vous allez avoir un impact - Préservez la qualité des données de la base installée mondiale pour nos produits haute tension fabriqués en Suisse - Établissez de solides relations de travail avec nos Gestionnaires de bases installés dans le monde entier, agissez comme leur contrepartie centrale et identifiez conjointement les goulets d'étranglement, les opportunités et les priorités - Préparez, analysez et enrichissez de grands ensembles de données, identifiez les erreurs et améliorez continuellement la qualité des données - Développez et maintenez des tableaux de bord Power BI et des analyses sur mesure qui permettent de renforcer les ventes de services, les directeurs de ventes régionaux et les équipes de dépannage technique - Livrez

Analyses numériques et tableaux de bord transfonctionnels qui créent une valeur au-delà de la base installée - Assurer une transmission sans heurt des données des nouvelles entreprises au service en étroite collaboration avec le département de la qualité et s'associer à la gestion du Service mobile pour maintenir l'exactitude des données sur le terrain

Votre expérience - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie industriel, informatique d'affaires, sciences des données ou domaine connexe; ouvert aux jeunes diplômés et aux candidats ayant quelques années d'expérience pertinente - Une solide mentalité analytique et une passion pour la qualité des données, avec des méthodes de travail structurées et reproductibles - Expérience avec Power BI, ou une motivation claire pour développer ces compétences; les connaissances SAP sont bénéfiques et SQL est un plus - Curiosity et un état d'esprit de résolution de problèmes: vous aimez creuser dans des sujets complexes et concevoir des solutions pragmatiques - Un équilibre de vision et

adaptabilité, avec confort pour guider les parties prenantes par le changement - Une solide collaboration et des compétences en communication entre les fonctions et les régions - L'anglais fluent est obligatoire; l'allemand et toute autre langue sont considérés comme un atout

En savoir plus sur nous Nous croyons que le travail est un véritable atout dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimentant l'engagement, la performance et la croissance.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Drive the BU supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and business alignment. Monitor sustainability trends, regulations, and customer requirements, integrating them into plans and processes. Standardize material sustainability processes and ensure effective implementation across the supply chain. Lead sustainability improvement initiatives, including decarbonization and supplier engagement. Track sustainability performance and drive continuous improvement through data-driven insights. Develop and maintain material sustainability data, enabling consistent LCA, EPD, and PCF assessments. Partner with suppliers and stakeholders to advance emission reduction and sustainable practices. Deliver training and promote best practices across the SCM community. Align and apply methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving standards. Support supplier requirements, material selection, environmental claims, and customer sustainability requests Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels. More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy cherche un responsable mondial de la durabilité des matériaux SCM pour les transformateurs de l'unité d'affaires de rejoindre notre équipe innovante et prospective. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la gestion de bout en bout du pilier Développement durable des matériaux, en alignant les méthodes d'évaluation des impacts environnementaux, en définissant les processus, en mettant en oeuvre des initiatives et en surveillant les progrès dans l'ensemble de l'unité opérationnelle. C'est l'occasion pour vous de vous conformer aux objectifs opérationnels et aux exigences réglementaires, de soutenir les objectifs de durabilité de l'organisation et d'avoir un impact significatif dans l'industrie de l'énergie. Comment vous ferez un impact Conduire la stratégie de durabilité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement BU, en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité matérielle et l'alignement des entreprises. Surveiller les tendances en matière de durabilité, les règlements et les exigences des clients, en les intégrant dans les plans et les processus. Normaliser les processus de durabilité matérielle et assurer une mise en œuvre efficace dans toute la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Diriger les initiatives d'amélioration de la durabilité, y compris la décarbonisation et l'engagement des fournisseurs. Suivre les performances en matière de durabilité et favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce à des données. Élaborer et tenir à jour des données sur la durabilité des matériaux, ce qui permettra d'effectuer des évaluations cohérentes de la LCA, de la DPE et de la PCF. Établir des partenariats avec les fournisseurs et les intervenants pour faire progresser la réduction des émissions et les pratiques durables. Offrir de la formation et promouvoir les pratiques exemplaires dans l'ensemble de la collectivité de MSC. Aligner et appliquer des méthodes d'évaluation des impacts environnementaux matériels conformément aux normes en évolution. Soutenir les exigences des fournisseurs, la sélection des matériaux, les revendications environnementales et les demandes de durabilité des clients Diplôme en sciences de l'environnement, en génie, en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou dans un domaine connexe. Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité, avec un leadership prouvé dans la création de stratégies et de feuilles de route, de préférence au sein des organisations mondiales ou à grande échelle. Forte expertise en matière de normes de durabilité des matériaux, telles que ISO 14067, ISO 14044, le Protocole sur les gaz à effet de serre et les cadres connexes. Expérience approfondie des évaluations du cycle de vie, des déclarations de produits environnementaux et de la mise en oeuvre de programmes mondiaux de durabilité liés aux matériaux et aux fournisseurs. De solides compétences en leadership avec une expérience de développement et d'exécution d'initiatives stratégiques dans des environnements internationaux complexes. Excellente communication, présentation et influence des compétences, avec la capacité d'établir des relations et d'inspirer le changement à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. Plus sur nous Nous croyons que le grand travail prospère dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et équitablement récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimenter l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En donnant la priorité au bien-être, nous construisons un lieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle se développe ensemble. descriptionByLocale.it:
L'occasione Unisciti a un team di ingegneria innovativo e collaborativo che modella il futuro della tecnologia ad alta tensione. Contribuirai allo sviluppo di interruttori SF6 di nuova generazione in un ambiente di supporto e condivisione delle conoscenze. Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica con simulazioni, misurazioni e strumenti dielettrici all'avanguardia. Imparerai da mentori esperti durante l'assunzione di compiti significativi. La posizione supporta l'apprendimento continuo, la curiosità e la crescita professionale. Sviluppo di supporti di interruttori ad alta tensione senza SF6 attraverso simulazioni e test Performi simulazioni di campi elettrici per supportare le decisioni di progettazione dielettrica Analizzare e valutare le misurazioni e i risultati dei test Mantenere ed espandere database di guasti tra cui i gas alternativi Utilizzo e sviluppare ulteriormente gli strumenti di valutazione dielettrica internamente stabiliti Contribuisci all'ottimizzazione della progettazione attraverso le intuzioni di simulazione e i test di base Collaborazione Siamo un'azienda tecnologica con una forte attenzione all'innovazione, al miglioramento continuo e alla produzione sostenibile.
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicato, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. Cittadini non UE/AELS, si prega di notare che un certificato universitario ufficiale che mostra che uno stage è una parte obbligatoria dei vostri studi è richiesto.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity Join an innovative and collaborative engineering team shaping the future of high-voltage technology. You will contribute to the development of next-generation SF6-free circuit breakers in a supportive and knowledge-sharing environment. This role offers hands-on experience with simulations, measurements, and cutting-edge dielectric tools. You will learn from experienced mentors while taking ownership of meaningful tasks. The position supports continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. How you'll make an impact Support development of SF6-free high-voltage circuit breakers through simulations and testing Perform electric field simulations to support dielectric design decisions Analyze and evaluate breakdown measurements and test results Maintain and expand breakdown databases including alternative gases Use and further develop internally established dielectric evaluation tools Contribute to design optimization through simulation insights and basic testing Collaborate with interdisciplinary project teams in circuit breaker development Conduct literature research on breakdown and flashover phenomena and extract relevant data including simulations (Comsol) Your background Enrolled Student (preferably Master) or Graduate in Physics, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Strong programming skills and interest in Python, Matlab, or Excel Fluent in written and spoken English Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills Ability to work collaboratively and take initiative independently Interest in high-voltage systems and simulation-based engineering (Comsol, CAD, Creo) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Treten Sie einem innovativen und kollaborativen Engineering-Team bei, das die Zukunft der Hochvolttechnologie gestaltet. Sie werden zur Entwicklung von SF6-freien Leistungsschaltern der nächsten Generation in einer unterstützenden und Wissensaustauschumgebung beitragen. Diese Rolle bietet praktische Erfahrung mit Simulationen, Messungen und innovativen dielektrischen Werkzeugen. Sie werden von erfahrenen Mentoren lernen, während Sie bedeutungsvolle Aufgaben übernehmen. Die Position unterstützt kontinuierliches Lernen, Neugier und berufliches Wachstum. Wie Sie die Entwicklung von SF6-freien Hochspannungsleistungsschaltern durch Simulationen und Tests unterstützen Durchführen von elektrischen Feldsimulationen zur Unterstützung dielektrischer Designentscheidungen Analyse und Bewertung von Durchbruchsmessungen und Testergebnissen Pflegen und Erweitern von Durchbruchsdatenbanken einschließlich alternativer Gase Verwenden und Entwickeln Sie intern etablierte dielektrische Bewertungstools Beitragen Sie zur Designoptimierung durch Simulationseinsichten und grundlegende Tests Arbeiten Sie mit interdisziplinären Projektteams in der Leistungsschalterentwicklung Durchführen Sie Literaturrecherche zu Ausfall- und Flashover-Phänomenen und extrahieren Sie relevante Daten einschließlich Simulationen (Comsol) Ihr Hintergrund Eingeschriebener Student (vorzugsweise Master) oder Absolvent in Physik, Mechanik, Elektrotechnik oder ein verwandtes Feld Starke Programmierkenntnisse und Interesse an Python, Matlab oder Excel Fluent in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch Analytisches Denken und strukturierte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten Fähigkeit, gemeinsam zu arbeiten und unabhängig Initiative zu ergreifen Interesse an Hochspannungssystemen und simulationsbasiertes Engineering (Comsol, CAD, Creo) Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung.
• Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich eines kurzen Anschreibens und einer Niederschrift der Aufzeichnungen, zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Nicht-EU-/EFTA-Bürger, bitte beachten Sie, dass ein offizielles Universitätszertifikat erforderlich ist, aus dem hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum ein obligatorischer Bestandteil Ihres Studiums ist.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'occasion Joignez-vous à une équipe d'ingénierie novatrice et collaborative qui façonne l'avenir de la technologie à haute tension. Vous contribuerez au développement de disjoncteurs sans SF6 de prochaine génération dans un environnement de soutien et de partage des connaissances. Ce rôle offre une expérience pratique avec des simulations, des mesures et des outils diélectriques de pointe. Vous apprendrez de mentors expérimentés tout en prenant en charge des tâches significatives. Le poste soutient l'apprentissage continu, la curiosité et la croissance professionnelle. Comment faire un impact Soutenir le développement de disjoncteurs haute tension sans SF6 par des simulations et des essais Effectuer des simulations de terrain électriques pour soutenir les décisions de conception diélectrique Analyser et évaluer les mesures de panne et les résultats des essais Maintenir et élargir les bases de données de panne, y compris les gaz de substitution Utiliser et développer davantage les outils d'évaluation diélectrique établis à l'interne Contribuer à concevoir des optimisations par des idées de simulation et des essais de base Collaborer avec des équipes de projet interdisciplinaires dans le développement des disjoncteurs Mener des recherches sur les phénomènes de panne et de flashover et extraire les données pertinentes, y compris les simulations (Comsol) Vos antécédents Étudiant inscrit (de préférence Master) ou diplômé en physique, en génie mécanique, en génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe Fortes compétences en programmation et intérêt pour Python, Matlab ou Excel Fluent dans l'anglais écrit et parlé Pensée analytique et compétences structurées en résolution de problèmes Capacité de travailler en collaboration et de prendre des initiatives indépendamment Intérêt dans les systèmes haute tension et l'ingénierie basée sur la simulation (Comsol, CAD, Creo) En savoir plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, qui met fortement l'accent sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.
• Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. Citoyens non-UE\/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel indiquant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.

jobs.description:

Du sorgst dafür, dass Materialien und Produkte sicher, effizient und termingerecht bewegt, gelagert und dokumentiert werden. Dabei kombinierst du praktische Lagerarbeit mit dem Einsatz moderner Hilfsmittel wie Gabelstapler oder Förderanlagen. Das kannst du bewirken Be- und Entladen von Generatorenschalter mittels Kran Kommissionieren, Verpacken und Versandvorbereitung von Aufträgen Bedienen von Flurförderfahrzeugen (z. B. Gabelstapler, Hubwagen) und Fördertechnik Materialbewegungen im SAP Pflege der Lagerbestände im IT-System Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Lager- und Logistikprozessen Unterstützung und Einarbeitung von Kolleg:innen mit weniger Erfahrung Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker EFZ oder mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung im Lager Staplerausweis und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Flurförderfahrzeugen von Vorteil Kranausweis von Vortiel Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Lagerverwaltungssystemen (SAP) wünschenswert Sorgfältige, zuverlässige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Mehr über uns Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem modernen und organisierten Lagerumfeld Abwechslungsreiche

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Per quanto riguarda la posizione di azienda logistica, sei un membro importante del nostro team logistico. Ti assicuri che i materiali e i prodotti siano spostati, immagazzinati e documentati in modo sicuro, efficiente e puntuale. Combina pratici lavori di stoccaggio con l'uso di strumenti moderni come carrelli elevatori o sistemi di trasporto.

Compiti - Carico e scarico degli interruttori del generatore mediante gru - Messa in servizio, imballaggio e spedizione preparazione degli ordini - Funzionamento dei carrelli elevatori (ad es. carrelli elevatori, carrelli elevatori) e tecnologia dei trasportatori - Movimenti materiali in SAP - Manutenzione delle scorte nel sistema IT - Partecipazione all'ottimizzazione dei processi di stoccaggio e logistica - Supporto e formazione dei colleghi con meno esperienza

Requisiti - Formazione completa come specialista della logistica EFZ o diversi anni di esperienza pratica nel magazzino - Cartolina elevatore ed esperienza nella movimentazione carrelli elevatori - Cartolina gru - Conoscenza nella movimentazione sistemi di gestione carrelli elevatori (SAP) desiderabile - Metodi di lavoro attenti, affidabili e responsabili - Capacità di squadra, flessibilità e disponibilità ad assumersi le responsabilità - Buona conoscenza tedesca in termini di parole e scrittura; Abilità inglesi utili

Offriamo - Un luogo di lavoro sicuro in un ambiente di magazzino moderno e organizzato - Un compito vario con responsabilità personale - Un team di 1 561 persone con comunicazione aperta - Condizioni di lavoro e benefici sociali attraenti - Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo ulteriore nel settore logistico
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

About the position as a logistics company you are an important member of our logistics team. You ensure that materials and products are moved, stored and documented safely, efficiently and on time. You combine practical storage work with the use of modern tools such as forklifts or conveyor systems.

Tasks - Loading and unloading of generator switches by crane - Commissioning, packaging and dispatch preparation of orders - Operating of forklift trucks (e.g. forklift trucks, lifting trucks) and conveyor technology - Material movements in SAP - Maintenance of stocks in the IT system - Participation in the optimization of storage and logistics processes - Support and training of colleagues with less experience

Requirements - Completed training as a logistics specialist EFZ or several years of practical experience in the warehouse - Forklift card and experience in handling forklift trucks - crane card - Knowledge in handling forklift management systems (SAP) desirable - Careful, reliable and responsible working methods - Team ability, flexibility and willingness to take responsibility - Good German knowledge in word and writing; English skills beneficial

We offer - A secure workplace in a modern and organized warehouse environment - A varied task with personal responsibility - A collegial team with open communication - Attractive employment conditions and social benefits - Opportunities for further training and further development in the logistics sector

Désignation des marchandises

Vous vous assurez que les matériaux et les produits sont déplacés, stockés et documentés en toute sécurité, efficacement et à temps. Vous combinez des travaux pratiques de stockage avec l'utilisation d'outils modernes tels que les chariots élévateurs ou les systèmes de convoyeurs.

Tâches - Chargement et déchargement des interrupteurs de générateur par grue - Mise en service, emballage et préparation des commandes - Fonctionnement des chariots élévateurs (par exemple chariots élévateurs, chariots élévateurs) et de la technologie des convoyeurs - Mouvements de matériel dans SAP - Maintenance des stocks dans le système informatique - Participation à l'optimisation des processus de stockage et de logistique - Soutien et formation des collègues ayant une expérience moindre

jobs.title: Project Control Engineer – Power Conversion 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   At our Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, and grid interconnections. Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency. To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems. If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity.   How you'll make an impact Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews Develop and implement control software, including testing on real-time simulation platforms Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management   Your background   Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's, from a university or university of applied sciences) Hands-on experience with MATLAB \/ Simulink is essential Strong knowledge of process control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI) Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time) Fluency in English and German   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.   Additionally, you can expect: Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team

descriptionByLocale.it: Al nostro Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, siamo in prima linea nello sviluppo, produzione, installazione e messa in servizio di convertitori elettronici ad alta potenza per applicazioni come STATCOM, sistemi di alimentazione ferroviaria e interconnessioni di rete. Le nostre soluzioni svolgono un ruolo chiave nel consentire l'integrazione delle energie rinnovabili nelle moderne reti elettriche, migliorando al contempo l'efficienza complessiva del sistema. Per rafforzare il nostro team di Control Engineering, stiamo cercando un motore di controllo del progetto motivato e pratico con un forte interesse per l'elettronica di potenza e sistemi di controllo. Se sei un apprendimento veloce con una mentalità strutturata e proattiva, e ti piace combinare lavoro di ingegneria con applicazioni reali - questa è la tua opportunità. Come farete un piano d'impatto ed eseguire gli aspetti di ingegneria di controllo dei progetti, compresi i concetti hardware e software, le specifiche e la documentazione Coordinate le interfacce tecniche tra i clienti, i sottofornitori, e i team interni Definire e valutare le interfacce hardware, compresi i componenti elettrici e le revisioni di progettazione Sviluppare e implementare il software di controllo, tra cui test su piattaforme di simulazione in tempo reale Perform commissioning, test e formazione del cliente sul sito Fornire supporto tecnico durante l'esecuzione e dopo la consegna L'esperienza Hands-on con MATLAB \/ Simulink è essenziale Forte conoscenza del controllo del processo e del software di progettazione (ad esempio OLC, CLC, Protezione, HMI) La familiarità con i protocolli di comunicazione industriale (ad esempio OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) è un'esperienza più iniziale nella sperimentazione, messa in servizio, o ingegneria applicata è un vantaggio che l'approvazione per l'assegnazione globale dei viaggi. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere. Inoltre, ci si può aspettare: Lavorare sulle tecnologie all'avanguardia nell'esperienza Power Electronics Hands-on in progetti internazionali e applicazioni nel mondo reale Una combinazione di simulazione, ingegneria e lavoro di progetto in loco Opportunità di crescere in un esperto tecnico all'interno di un business in rapida sviluppo Collaborazione all'interno di un team di ingegneria altamente qualificato e internazionale

Unsere Lösungen spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Integration erneuerbarer Energien in moderne Stromnetze bei gleichzeitiger Verbesserung der Gesamtsystemeffizienz. Zur Stärkung unseres Control Engineering Teams suchen wir einen motivierten und praxisnahen Projektleittechniker mit starkem Interesse an Leistungselektronik und Steuerung. Wenn Sie ein schneller Lernender mit einer strukturierten und proaktiven Denkweise sind und es genießen, Ingenieurarbeit mit realen Anwendungen zu kombinieren, ist dies Ihre Chance. Darüber hinaus können Sie erwarten: Arbeiten an innovativen Technologien in Power Electronics Praktische Erfahrung in internationalen Projekten und realen Anwendungen Eine Kombination aus Simulation, Engineering und Projektarbeit vor Ort Gelegenheit, in einem sich schnell entwickelnden Business zum technischen Experten zu werden Zusammenarbeit in einem hochqualifizierten, internationalen Engineering-Team
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Au sein de notre Centre de Compétences, nous sommes à l'avant-garde du développement, de la fabrication, de l'installation et de la mise en service de convertisseurs électroniques haute puissance pour des applications telles que STATCOM, les systèmes d'alimentation électrique ferroviaire et les interconnexions de réseau. Nos solutions jouent un rôle clé dans l'intégration des énergies renouvelables dans les réseaux électriques modernes tout en améliorant l'efficacité globale du système. jobs.title: Research Scientist - Gas Insulation for High Voltage (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join Hitachi Energy and shape sustainable high-voltage technologies. You will join an international R&D team focused on gas insulation. The team develops eco-efficient solutions for high-voltage applications. You will work on advanced research and industrial implementation. You will contribute to cutting-edge projects in gas-insulated switchgear. You will collaborate across research centers and business units. The role offers exposure to both theory and practical testing. You will grow your expertise in high-voltage engineering and gas physics. You will strengthen your skills in simulations and experimental methods. You will work in a collaborative and diverse environment. This role offers strong development opportunities and technical ownership. You will contribute to future-ready, sustainable energy solutions.   How you'll make an impact Actively contribute to research projects in gas insulation applications Conduct investigations on dielectric strength, dielectric recovery, partial discharge Plan and execute high-voltage experimental studies Model, simulate, interpret gas discharge phenomena Develop innovative concepts for gas-insulated technologies Support design and optimization of HV switchgear Collaborate with global teams and external research institutes Document results, publish findings and present your work at international conferences   Your background   PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related field with application in high voltage engineering Strong knowledge of gas insulation and discharge physics Practical experience in HV testing Expertise in simulation tools such as MATLAB, Python, or COMSOL Ability to analyze complex datasets and interpret results using statistical methods, modern AI tools Solid English communication skills and structured working style Relevant experience in industrial R&D is very beneficial   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Equipment Engineer -Diffusion, 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity    Join Hitachi, Ltd. as an Equipment Engineer and play a key role in optimizing and maintaining manufacturing equipment to ensure high performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes.  As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of semiconductor high temperature production systems. This role focuses on the Corrective and Preventive maintenance and optimization of Diffusion & Cleaning equipment while working closely with cross-functional teams to enhance safety, productivity, and system reliability. How you'll make an impact  Develop and implement modifications and upgrades to existing manufacturing equipment to improve efficiency, yield, and safety  Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex manufacturing machinery and systems  Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and implement preventive measures  Collaborate with production, R&D, and quality teams to resolve equipment-related issues and optimize processes  Create and maintain documentation for equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and technical specifications  Train technicians and operators on new equipment and updated procedures  Manage spare parts inventory and ensure timely procurement of required components and ensure compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations  Support the selection, installation, and qualification of new manufacturing equipment  Your background  Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or electrical Engineering  Minimum 2 years of experience in equipment engineering within a manufacturing environment  Experience in the Semiconductor field is highly desirable Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, and pneumatics; experience with Diffusion Semiconductor systems is a plus (e.g., ASM, Centrotherm furnaces) Proven ability to troubleshoot complex machinery and identify root causes of failures  Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methods  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills  Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment  English is mandatory, German is beneficial   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a Hitachi, Ltd. come ingegnere di attrezzature e gioca un ruolo chiave nell'ottimizzazione e manutenzione delle attrezzature di produzione per garantire elevate prestazioni, affidabilità ed efficienza. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente collaborativo, contribuendo al miglioramento continuo e al supporto di processi produttivi innovativi. Come Ingegnere di Manutenzione Diffusion, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire la disponibilità, l'efficienza e il miglioramento continuo dei sistemi di produzione ad alta temperatura semiconduttore. Questo ruolo si concentra sulla manutenzione e ottimizzazione Correttiva e Preventiva delle apparecchiature Diffusion & Cleaning, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team interfunzionali per migliorare la sicurezza, la produttività e l'affidabilità del sistema. descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Join Hitachi, Ltd. as an Equipment Engineer and play a key role in optimizing and maintaining manufacturing equipment to ensure high performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes. As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of semiconductor high temperature production systems. This role focuses on the Corrective and Preventive maintenance and optimization of Diffusion & Cleaning equipment while working closely with cross-functional teams to enhance safety, productivity, and system reliability. How you'll make an impact Develop and implement modifications and upgrades to existing manufacturing equipment to improve efficiency, yield, and safety Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex manufacturing machinery and systems Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and implement preventive measures Collaborate with production, R&D, and quality teams to resolve equipment-related issues and optimize processes Create and maintain documentation for equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and technical specifications Train technicians and operators on new equipment and updated procedures Manage spare parts inventory and ensure timely procurement of required components and ensure compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations Support the selection, installation, and qualification of new manufacturing equipment Your background Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or electrical Engineering Minimum 2 years of experience in equipment engineering within a manufacturing environment Experience in the Semiconductor field is highly desirable Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, and pneumatics; experience with Diffusion Semiconductor systems is a plus (e.g., ASM, Centrotherm furnaces) Proven ability to troubleshoot complex machinery and identify root causes of failures Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methods Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment English is mandatory, German is beneficial More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Secondary Design Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Secondary Design Engineer to join our GIS engineering team. In this role, you will support the execution of secondary engineering deliverables for high-voltage GIS projects, including Local Control Cabinet (LCC) and digital substation applications. You will contribute to engineering documentation across project phases and help deliver high-quality, standard-compliant results while building your expertise in secondary design engineering and tools such as Zuken E3. How you'll make an impact Prepare schematics and related engineering documents for GIS secondary engineering scopes, including LCC and digital substation applications Support engineering execution across project phases, from base design and detail design through manufacturing documentation and as-built updates Create preliminary BOMs, reports, and manufacturing documents using approved engineering tools and standard processes Perform structured self-checks and contribute to technically correct, high-quality, and standard-compliant deliverables Support technical clarifications with internal stakeholders, project teams, and factories, and help document and close open points Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and engineering best practices, including participation in relevant expert communities Apply internal guidelines, engineering standards, and quality requirements while supporting safe and efficient project execution Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline 2–3 years of professional experience in secondary engineering, design engineering, or project engineering is expected Practical experience with engineering tools such as Zuken E3 or comparable ECAD \/ engineering tools is required Basic knowledge of GIS, secondary engineering principles, and applicable standards such as IEC, IEEE, or ANSI is beneficial Structured and reliable way of working, willingness to learn, and ability to collaborate across functions and disciplines Fluency in English is required; German and other languages are an advantage More about us Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. You will work in a collaborative and international environment where innovation, learning, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend - Assembly 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia ad alte prestazioni in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. In qualità di Senior Photolithography Engineer, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. Questa è la vostra opportunità per modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi nella stabilità, uptime e le prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprietà, prospera in un ambiente frenetico e gode di un impatto reale? Allora applica oggi! Come farete un impatto Assicuratevi che i processi soddisfino il programma di produzione e gli obiettivi di resa e affrontino eventuali problemi di resa e rielaborazione dei prodotti. Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione. Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo. Analizzare i dati di processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (implementazione e controllare regolarmente SPC). Progettazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione. Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità. Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay. I dazi doganali nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con la partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di pagamento) hanno concordato sulla propria responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call. La tua laurea di primo livello in un campo relativo (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel Ph.D. con esperienza nell'industria Estensiva esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer soprattutto nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione wafer (testa di film, wafer semiconduttore) Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con l'estrazione dei dati, la manipolazione e l'analisi Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione La competenza nella scienza e nella programmazione dei dati è preferita Buon Inglese e Tedesco competenze linguistiche Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito Più su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Ihre Aufgabe besteht darin, mit fortschrittlichen Lithografiegeräten zu arbeiten, mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und qualitativ hochwertige Produktionsstandards zu gewährleisten. Engagieren Sie sich mit Ausrüstungs- und Materialanbietern, um neue Lösungen zu entwickeln und bestehende Prozesse zu verbessern, um einen reibungslosen Betrieb der Produktionslinie zu gewährleisten. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Joignez-vous à une équipe de photolithographie performante où votre expertise fait vraiment un impact. En tant qu'ingénieur principal en photolithographie, vous serez responsable du développement et de l'optimisation des processus de photolithographie utilisés dans la fabrication de semi-conducteurs. Votre rôle consistera à travailler avec des équipements de lithographie avancés, à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et à garantir des normes de production de haute qualité. C'est l'occasion pour vous d'élaborer des décisions techniques, de contribuer à des stratégies d'outils à long terme et d'apporter des améliorations significatives à la stabilité, à la disponibilité et au rendement des processus. Êtes-vous quelqu'un qui prend possession, prospère dans un environnement rapide, et aime faire un impact réel? Alors appliquez aujourd'hui ! Comment vous ferez un impact Assurez-vous que les processus répondent aux objectifs du programme de production et de rendement et qu'ils traitent de tout problème de rendement et de retravail. Mobiliser les fournisseurs d'équipements et de matériaux pour développer de nouvelles solutions et améliorer les processus existants, pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la chaîne de production.
