jobs.title: Industrial Engineer for GIS Production 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer – Transformer Service (Traction/Rail) 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un Service Sales Engineer per la nostra Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, a Ginevra (Svizzera). Segnalando a Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager supporterai l'organizzazione Vendite e i clienti durante il processo di vendita nell'area assegnata. Sarete parte del Team Vendite che si concentra sul Servizio Trasformatore Trazione in Europa. In qualità di Service Sales Engineer è il vostro compito emozionante per facilitare la transizione della mobilità sostenibile da un portafoglio di prodotti ferroviari all'avanguardia e servizi ferroviari per le apparecchiature di rotolamento stock. In questo team, lavorerai con i colleghi internazionali che hanno molti anni di esperienza all'interno del business di servizio del trasformatore di trazione on-board per le apparecchiature di rolling stock. Con sede a Ginevra, il ruolo si assumerà la responsabilità per i clienti ferroviari in Europa (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing). Se sei un ingegnere altamente qualificato e motivato che cerca di unirsi a un team dinamico, ti invitiamo a applicare. Sostenere il team di vendita e i clienti in tutto il processo di vendita, sviluppando al tempo stesso nuovi e esistenti business aumentando la conoscenza interna ed esterna dei prodotti e del mercato Preparazione dell'offerta tecnica in conformità con il portafoglio unità e la necessità del cliente. Rivendicare gli aspetti tecnici e commerciali dell'offerta Partecipando alle discussioni sulla strategia di vendita, assegnando obiettivi a breve e a lungo termine e negoziando i vari budget di vendita del Gruppo di prodotti e piani di marketing Identificare le esigenze dei clienti e le offerte dei concorrenti attraverso l'analisi del mercato, assicurando un'efficace azione di marketing e comunicazione dimostra la proposizione di valore dei prodotti, sistemi, servizi e pacchetti La tua laurea di primo livello in ingegneria e più di 2 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite dirette e delle vendite La conoscenza del mercato delle ferrovie e dei clienti ferroviari (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing) è un vantaggio Fluente in francese e inglese, sia scritto che parlato. Altre lingue sono un vantaggio Esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, gestione del conto e cross-selling attraverso sistemi, soluzioni, prodotti e categorie di servizi Comprensione di preparazione dell'offerta, negoziazione del contratto, gestione del rischio e termini commerciali e legali Viaggiare principalmente all'interno dell'Unione Europea se necessario. descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen Service Sales Engineer für unsere Traction Transformers Service Business Unit in Genf (Schweiz). Berichterstattung an den Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager Sie werden die Verkaufsorganisation und Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses in dem zugewiesenen Bereich unterstützen. Sie werden Teil des Verkaufsteams sein, das sich auf Traction Transformer Service in Europa konzentriert. Als Service Sales Engineer ist es Ihre spannende Aufgabe, die nachhaltige Mobilitätswende durch ein hochmodernes Schienenprodukt- und Schienendienstleistungsportfolio für Fahrzeuge zu ermöglichen. In diesem Team arbeiten Sie mit internationalen Kollegen zusammen, die über langjährige Erfahrung im Bereich der On-Board-Traktionstransformatoren-Services für Fahrzeuge verfügen. Mit Sitz in Genf übernimmt die Rolle Verantwortung für die Bahnkunden in Europa (OEM-Zughersteller, Bahnbetreiber, Leasinggesellschaften). Wenn Sie ein hochqualifizierter und motivierter Ingenieur sind, der sich einem dynamischen Team anschließen möchte, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wie Sie Einfluss darauf haben, das Verkaufsteam und die Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses zu unterstützen, während Sie neues und bestehendes Geschäft entwickeln, indem Sie das interne und externe Wissen über Produkte und den Markt erweitern. Klären der technischen und kommerziellen Aspekte des Angebots Teilnahme an Verkaufsstrategie Diskussionen, Zuweisung kurz- und langfristiger Ziele und Verhandlungen der verschiedenen Produktgruppe Verkaufsbudgets und Marketingpläne Identifizierung der Kundenbedürfnisse und Konkurrenzangebote durch Marktanalyse, Gewährleistung effizienter Marketingaktionen und Kommunikationen zeigen das Wertversprechen der Produkte, Systeme, Service und Pakete Unterstützung des Bereichs Verkaufsorganisation / Kunden bei der Bestimmung der technisch angemessensten und kosteneffektivsten Lösungen und Bereitstellung von technischem Support, Produktpräsentationen und Produkt / Lösung / Service-bezogenes Training Übernahme der Verantwortung für spezifische Kundenfälle, um eine effiziente Lösung von Kundenproblemen zu gewährleisten und die zukünftige Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu erhöhen Durchführung von Verkaufsleistungsüberprüfungen, Vorschlag von Wiederherstellungsplänen in Fällen von möglichen Auftragslücken und Bereitstellung regelmäßiger Verkaufsaktivitäten Berichte zur Unterstützung bei der Produktionsplanung Leben Kernwerte der Sicherheit und Integrität, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihre eigenen Handlungen zu übernehmen, während Sie sich um Ihre Kollegen und das Unternehmen kümmern Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften und mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Direktvertrieb und Vertriebsmanagement Kenntnisse des Schienenfahrzeugmarktes und der Schienenkunden (OEM-Zughersteller, Bahnbetreiber, Leasinggesellschaften) sind ein Vorteil, der sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich fließend Französisch und Englisch spricht. Andere Sprachen sind ein Vorteil Erfahrung in der Geschäftsentwicklung, Kontoverwaltung und Cross-Selling über Systeme, Lösungen, Produkte und Dienstleistungskategorien Verständnis der Angebotsvorbereitung, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risikomanagement und kommerzielle und rechtliche Begriffe Reisen vor allem innerhalb der Europäischen Union, wenn nötig. Häufige Interaktion mit Bahnkunden und HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team werden erwartet Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Service Sales Engineer pour notre Unité Service Transformateurs de Traction, à Genève (Suisse). Relevant du Service de Traction Sales and Marketing Manager, vous accompagnerez l'organisation des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente dans la zone affectée. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe des ventes qui se concentre sur le service Transformateur de Traction en Europe. En tant que Service Sales Engineer, il s'agit de votre tâche passionnante de faciliter la transition vers une mobilité durable grâce à un portefeuille de produits ferroviaires de pointe et de services ferroviaires pour le matériel roulant. Dans cette équipe, vous travaillerez avec des pairs internationaux ayant de nombreuses années d'expérience dans le domaine des transformateurs de traction embarqués pour le matériel roulant. Basé à Genève, ce rôle assumera la responsabilité des clients ferroviaires en Europe (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location). Si vous êtes un ingénieur hautement qualifié et motivé cherchant à rejoindre une équipe dynamique, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Soutenir l'équipe des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente, tout en développant des activités nouvelles et existantes en augmentant les connaissances internes et externes des produits et du marché. Clarifier les aspects techniques et commerciaux de l'offre Participer aux discussions sur la stratégie de vente, assigner des objectifs à court et à long terme et négocier les divers budgets de vente et plans de marketing du Groupe de produits Identifier les besoins des clients et les offres des concurrents par l'analyse du marché, assurer des actions de marketing et des communications efficaces démontrer la proposition de valeur des produits, des systèmes, des services et des forfaits Soutenir la région Organisme de vente/clients pour déterminer les solutions les plus appropriées et les plus rentables sur le plan technique et fournir un soutien technique, des présentations de produits et une formation liée au produit\/solution\/service. Votre formation Baccalauréat en ingénierie et plus de 2 ans d'expérience en vente directe et gestion des ventes Connaissance du marché du matériel roulant ferroviaire et des clients du rail (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location) est un avantage Fluent en français et en anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé. D'autres langues sont un avantage Expérience dans le développement des entreprises, la gestion des comptes et la vente croisée entre les systèmes, les solutions, les produits et les catégories de services Compréhension de la préparation des offres, de la négociation des contrats, de la gestion des risques et des termes commerciaux et juridiques Voyageant principalement au sein de l'Union européenne si nécessaire. Une interaction fréquente avec les clients ferroviaires et HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team sont attendues Plus sur nous Nos méthodes de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles et à créer un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. In dieser zentralen Funktion verantwortest du Initiativen zum Schutz unserer Mitarbeitenden, stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Vorschriften sicher und förderst eine proaktive Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur im gesamten Unternehmen. Das kannst du bewirken Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie interner Richtlinien Durchführen von Risiko‑, Gefahren‑ und Umweltanalysen inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Planen und Durchführen von internen Audits, Begehungen und Umweltkontrollen Untersuchen von Unfällen und Ereignissen sowie Erarbeitung von Präventionsmassnahmen Mitarbeit an Nachhaltigkeit‑ und Umweltprojekten sowie Förderung der Umweltkultur Erstellen und Durchführen von Schulungen zu Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsrelevanten Themen Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Projektteams bei HSE‑Fragestellungen Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Auditoren und externen Partnern Das bringst du mit Abschluss in Umweltwissenschaften, Umwelttechnik, Arbeitssicherheit oder einem vergleichbaren technischen\/naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (FH\/Universität) Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im HSE oder Umweltbereich, idealerweise in Industrie, Produktion oder technischen Organisationen Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Arbeitssicherheits- und Umweltgesetzgebung, inklusive relevanter Verordnungen (z. B. Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it: Attraverso la posizione, plasmare attivamente il futuro – dove la sicurezza e l'innovazione si incontrano. Siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista ambientale impegnato e competente o di uno specialista ambientale dedicato e competente che rafforza ulteriormente il nostro impegno per un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, sano e sostenibile. In questa funzione centrale, sei responsabile di iniziative per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, garantire il rispetto delle normative pertinenti e promuovere una sicurezza proattiva e la cultura ambientale in tutta l'azienda. L'utente può raggiungere questo obiettivo garantendo il rispetto delle normative ambientali e di sicurezza, nonché delle linee guida interne per l'esecuzione di analisi dei rischi, dei rischi e dell'ambiente, compresa la derivazione di misure Pianificazione e realizzazione di audit interni, controlli e controlli ambientali. Con una laurea in scienze ambientali, tecnologia ambientale, sicurezza sul lavoro o un'area di scienze tecniche / naturali comparabili (FH / università) Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel settore HSE o ambientale, idealmente nell'industria, nella produzione o nelle organizzazioni tecniche Conoscenza approfondita della legislazione svizzera in materia di sicurezza sul lavoro e sull'ambiente, compresi i regolamenti pertinenti (per esempio il diritto di incidente e di incidente, la legge sulle sostanze chimiche, la legge sulla tutela dell'ambiente) Esperienza nella realizzazione di analisi dei rischi, determinazione dei rischi e chiarificazione degli incidenti e degli eventi, compresa la derivazione delle misure Pratiche nella pianificazione, implementazione e follow-up di audit, ispezioni e ispezioni interne, idealmente secondo ISO 14001 \ / ISO 45001 Forte capacità di comunicazione e consulenza per sostenere manager, project manager e dipendenti in materia HSE Capacità di creare e svolgere formazione sulla sicurezza, l'ambiente e la sostenibilità, nonché competenze analitiche e l'esperienza in tedesco
descriptionByLocale.en: Through the position, actively shape the future – where security and innovation meet. We are looking for a committed and competent environmental specialist or a dedicated and competent environmental specialist who further strengthens our commitment to a safe, healthy and sustainable working environment. In this central function, you are responsible for initiatives to protect our employees, ensure compliance with relevant regulations and promote a proactive safety and environmental culture throughout the company. You can achieve this by ensuring compliance with environmental and safety regulations as well as internal guidelines Performing risk, hazard and environmental analyses including derivation of measures Planning and carrying out internal audits, inspections and environmental controls Investigating accidents and events as well as development of prevention measures Collaboration in sustainability and environmental projects as well as promotion of environmental culture Establishing and carrying out training on environmental and safety-related topics Advising and supporting managers and project teams on HSE issues Cooperation with authorities, auditors and external partners With a degree in environmental sciences, environmental technology, occupational safety or a comparable technical / natural sciences area (FH / university) Several years of professional experience in the HSE or environmental sector, ideally in industry, production or technical organizations In-depth knowledge of Swiss occupational safety and environmental legislation, including relevant regulations (e.g. accident and incident law, chemicals law, environmental protection law) Experience in carrying out risk analyses, hazard determinations as well as accident and event clarification, including derivation of measures Practice in the planning, implementation and follow-up of audits, inspections and internal inspections, ideally according to ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Strong communication and consulting skills for supporting managers, project managers and employees in HSE matters Ability to create and carry out training on occupational safety, environment and sustainability, as well as analytical skills and experience in dealing with HSE indicators, reporting and continuous improvement Very good knowledge of German as well as good knowledge of English.

jobs.title: Kaufmännischer Projektmanager – Transformatoren 80 – 100 % (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem internationalen Team spannende Projekte im Bereich Transformatoren realisieren? Du bringst Erfahrung im kundenorientierten und kostenoptimierten Projektmanagement mit und möchtest aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung eines dynamischen Umfelds beitragen? Bereit, die Zukunft mitzugestalten – idealerweise im süddeutschen Raum? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Das kannst du bewirken Verantwortung für mittlere bis große Projekte im Transformatorengeschäft Steuerung und Überwachung der Projektanforderungen, einschließlich Zeitplänen, Dokumentation, Projektoptimierungen, Kostenkontrolle, Projektzielen und Risikobewertungen Klärung technischer Details mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern nach Auftragseingang Zentrale Ansprechperson für die interne und externe Projektkommunikation, sowohl gegenüber Kunden als auch dem Produktionsstandort Sicherstellung eines erfolgreichen Projektabschlusses gemäß vertraglichen Bedingungen und internen Richtlinien Verantwortung für Claim- und Reklamationsmanagement zur Minimierung potenzieller Geschäftsrisiken Dein Hintergrund Studium der Elektrotechnik, des Maschinenbaus oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im komplexen Projektmanagement, idealerweise mit mehreren parallellaufenden Projekten Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Transformatoren, Kenntnisse in der Hochspannungstechnik sind von Vorteil Erfahrung im Claim- und Risikomanagement Gute Kenntnisse im Vertragsrecht Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) ist ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.   --- English translation below --- Commercial Project Manager – Transformers 80 – 100% (f\/m\/d)   The opportunity Would you like to deliver exciting transformer projects as part of an international team? Do you bring experience in customer-focused and cost-optimized project management and want to actively contribute to the development of a dynamic environment? Ready to help shape the future? Then apply now! How you'll make an impact Responsibility for medium to large projects in the transformer business Management and monitoring of project requirements including schedules, documentation, project optimizations, cost control, project objectives, and risk assessments Clarification of technical details with customers and internal stakeholders following order placement Acting as the central point of contact for internal and external project communication, both with customers and production site Ensuring successful project completion in accordance with contractual conditions and internal guidelines Ownership of claims and complaint management to prevent potential business risks Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field At least 8 years of experience in project management, ideally involving multiple parallel projects In-depth knowledge in transformers, knowledge in High Voltage technology is a plus Experience in claims and risk management Solid understanding of contract law Fluency in German and English, French is a plus Project management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Vuoi realizzare progetti entusiasmanti nel campo dei trasformatori in un team internazionale? Hai esperienza nella gestione del progetto orientata al cliente e ottimizzata ai costi e vorresti contribuire attivamente all'ulteriore sviluppo di un ambiente dinamico? Pronti a plasmare il futuro – idealmente nel sud della Germania? Quindi applicare ora! descriptionByLocale.en:

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. Your background Completed apprenticeship in the metal construction, electrical or automotive industry, or similar Basic knowledge in electrical engineering is a desirable must, further training in electrical engineering is an advantage Work experience in assembly & commissioning is an advantage Very good German and good English skills, at least B2 Willingness for national and especially international worldwide assignments with up to 90 % travel time Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional solutions with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptionByLocale.it: L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile per il mondo dopo il supporto di vendita di sistemi generatore-rompatore (GCB) e commutatori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi di valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, retrofit e sostituzioni. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza globale, apprezzerete il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione pratica e versatile in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai nuove installazioni GIS in tutto il mondo. Una posizione tecnicamente impegnativa in un ambiente multiculturale vi aspetta. Si può aspettare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere in esso. Senior così come le applicazioni junior sono benvenuti! Gestione di siti di costruzione multiculturali in tutto il mondo per interruttori isolati a gas per il livello di tensione di 110KV - 550KV. Responsabile per la riuscita dell'esecuzione dell'installazione in loco \/ manutenzione \/ riparazioni in conformità alle scadenze contrattuali e nel rispetto dei requisiti legali locali. Responsabile della qualità del lavoro svolto in loco attraverso il controllo della qualità e la valutazione delle competenze del personale di supporto locale. Condurre la formazione del prodotto in loco sul prodotto e durante l'installazione (opzionale). Coordinamento del lavoro locale. Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e reporting regolare alla gestione del progetto. Contribuire attivamente ai miglioramenti del processo e adottare proattivamente misure per aumentare l'efficienza delle attività in loco. Il tuo background Apprendistato completo nella costruzione di metalli, nell'industria elettrica o nel settore automobilistico, o simili La conoscenza di base nell'ingegneria elettrica è un must desiderabile, ulteriore formazione nell'ingegneria elettrica è un vantaggio L'esperienza di lavoro nell'assemblaggio e nella messa in servizio è un vantaggio Molto buono tedesco e buone abilità inglesi, almeno B2 Volontà per compiti nazionali e soprattutto internazionali in tutto il mondo con un tempo di viaggio flessibile, resiliente e comunicativo Un pacchetto di benefici interessanti che comprende spese fisse, di viaggio e di pasto, così come una voce nella scelta di alloggio

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. L'unité de service est responsable de l'appui après vente dans le monde entier des systèmes de disjoncteurs de générateurs (GCB) et des commutateurs isolés de gaz (GIS), y compris la formation, l'installation et la mise en service, l'entretien programmé, les services à valeur ajoutée, le dépannage, les extensions, les mises à niveau et les remplacements. Le service est la clé du succès. En tant que collègue de notre équipe de service active au niveau mondial, vous apprécierez le travail indépendant, varié et axé sur la solution. Après une formation polyvalente et pratique en Suisse et à l'étranger, vous dirigerez de nouvelles installations SIG à travers le monde. Une position techniquement difficile dans un environnement multiculturel vous attend. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et s'y développer. Les candidatures senior et junior sont les bienvenues! Responsable de la qualité du travail effectué sur place grâce au contrôle de la qualité et à l ' évaluation des compétences du personnel d ' appui local. Contribuer activement à l'amélioration des processus et prendre des mesures proactives pour accroître l'efficacité des activités sur place. jobs.title: Global Product Specialists Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist per unire il nostro team innovativo in [location]. In questo ruolo, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella gestione del portafoglio prodotti trasformatori, condurre analisi di mercato, e sostenere lo sviluppo di prodotti all'avanguardia. Questa posizione non solo offre la possibilità di ampliare le tue competenze e conoscenze nell'industria energetica, ma offre anche l'opportunità di contribuire a soluzioni trasformative che promuovono la sostenibilità e promuovano la tua carriera in un mercato in rapida evoluzione. Condurre un'analisi approfondita del mercato per identificare le tendenze e valutare il loro impatto sul portafoglio Transformer. Fornire una nuova prospettiva nel differenziare una tecnologia matura e un prodotto nel mercato analizzando le tendenze del mercato, comprendendo le esigenze dei clienti e monitorando le azioni dei concorrenti con un approccio innovativo e creativo. Valutare i requisiti tecnici e svolgere valutazioni competitive per individuare le lacune dei prodotti e le opportunità di miglioramento. Superare le iniziative di miglioramento delle prestazioni attraverso benchmarking e feedback di qualità sui prodotti assegnati. Assicurare la conformità alle normative internazionali e agli standard del settore in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Sostenere lo sviluppo di nuovi prodotti traducendo i requisiti di mercato in input attuabili per la roadmap del prodotto. Preparare e presentare materiali di comunicazione tecnica per supportare i lanci del prodotto e migliorare il posizionamento del mercato. Sviluppare e fornire sessioni di formazione coinvolgenti per abilitare i team interfunzionali con le più recenti conoscenze di prodotto e approfondimenti di mercato. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili. Vivere i valori fondamentali della sicurezza e dell'integrità di Hitachi Energy, il che significa assumersi la responsabilità delle proprie azioni mentre si occupano dei vostri colleghi e degli affari. La tua laurea in Ingegneria, Business Administration, Marketing o un campo relativo. Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti, nell'analisi del mercato o in un ruolo simile all'interno dei trasformatori o dell'industria energetica. Forte comprensione tecnica delle soluzioni energetiche e delle tecnologie industriali per comunicare efficacemente i benefici del prodotto e differenziare le offerte. Capacità comprovata di condurre analisi del mercato e valutazioni competitive per guidare lo sviluppo del prodotto. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione sia per il pubblico tecnico che non tecnico. Capacità di lavorare in collaborazione tra team interfunzionali e gestire più progetti contemporaneamente

jobs.title: Field Service Technician (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products ist der weltweit anerkannte Spezialist für Energieübertragung und Energieverteilung. Die Serviceeinheit ist für den weltweiten After Sales Support von Generatorenschutzschaltersystemen (GCB) und gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) inklusive Schulungen, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, planmäßiger Wartung, Zusatzleistungen, Troubleshooting, Erweiterungen, Umbauten und Austausch zuständig. Service ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Als Kollege\/-in in unserem weltweit tätigen Service Team schätzen Sie die selbstständige, abwechslungsreiche und lösungsorientierte Arbeit. Nach einer vielseitigen, praxisorientierten Ausbildung in der Schweiz und im Ausland, werden Sie rund um den Globus GIS Installationen und Wartungen leiten. jobs.description: The opportunity Join our Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) team and contribute to products that shape the reliability and performance of power generation worldwide. In this role, you will lead and support a motivated team of CAD Designers while collaborating closely with experienced engineers, project leads suppliers, and the in Oerlikon located factory across the entire product lifecycle—from early design concepts to continuous improvement initiatives. You will have the chance to make a real impact by driving high quality design practices, fostering unified working methods, and championing process and documentation excellence. Through a structured introduction program, you will gain the independence and confidence needed to steer your team effectively, while benefiting from targeted training and development opportunities that support your professional growth. jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to homes, schools, hospitals, and industries — and we do so with people who are passionate, collaborative, and committed to making a real difference. As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact  
• Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team
• Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement
• Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams
• Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization
• Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment
• Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions
• Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities
• Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation
• Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background  
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
• 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products
• Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies
• Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills
• Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.
